text: Level two, question three: a population of one lakh increases ten percent in year one and decreases ten percent in year two; find the final population. Question four: a machine's value falls from eighty thousand rupees to sixty-four thousand eight hundred in two years, at the same rate each year; find the rate. Question five: a town's population is fourteen thousand four hundred after growing twenty percent per year for two years; what was it two years ago?
